Upon examining the code for `DataFrame.__init__()`, we find that there is a condition to check if all elements in the data array are scalars (lines 487-493). If this condition is met and no index is provided (`index` is None), a `ValueError` is raised with the message "If all scalar values are used, an index must be passed".

In the test case, `data` is a 2D NumPy array without any index specified, which matches the condition in lines 487-493. Therefore, the `ValueError` is raised because no index was provided for the scalar data.

To fix this issue, either provide an index when constructing the DataFrame from a 2D NumPy array with all scalar values, or ensure that not all elements are scalars so that the condition in lines 487-493 is not met.
